name: Incoherent Projection
definition: A projection method for general convex hexahedra that renders the 2D projection of each cell as an arrangement of polygons by analyzing each cell individually in screen space, avoiding case analysis for the high number of projection topologies.
summary: Incoherent projection is a cell-based volume rendering method that decomposes each convex hexahedron's silhouette into planar polygons, handling irregular grids by analyzing individual cell topologies rather than assuming uniformity.
